offering_description.value: Operates online and live auction marketplaces that sell used industrial equipment, trucks and vehicles on behalf of owners to dealers, contractors and fleet buyers worldwide. Earns fees from sellers and buyers and offers valuation, financing and asset disposition services.

primary_services.value: auction services; online equipment marketplace; asset disposition; equipment valuation; financing services

customer_segment.value: B2B: equipment sellers, dealers, contractors, fleet operators, lenders and insurers; B2G: government agencies selling surplus equipment

end_markets.value: construction; transportation and trucking; agriculture; energy; mining

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: auction fees charged to sellers and buyers on sold equipment; service fees: fees for asset disposition, valuation, logistics and inspection services; advertising: paid listings and marketing on online marketplace platforms
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees; advertising

value_chain_position.value: service provider: runs auctions and disposition for owners, sold to equipment buyers; software / platform: operates online bidding and listing platforms for industrial equipment buyers and sellers

geography_served.value: global: Auction sites and buyers across North America, Europe, Asia, Australia and the Middle East

specialization.value: related lines: live and online auctions, IronPlanet online marketplace, Rouse asset disposition, Machinio listings, valuation and financing

distribution_channels.value: online: online bidding and listing platforms for global buyers; own locations: physical auction sites hosting live industrial equipment sales; direct sales: sales teams signing equipment owners and fleet customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Cross-border sales, customs, consumer protection and auctioneer licensing rules in various jurisdictions
